svg.title: ANSI/ISA-101 4-Tier Supervisory Display Hierarchy
svg.desc: Four-tier display hierarchy showing Level 1 Overview (KPIs), Level 2 Unit Control (P&ID with MAIs), Level 3 Detail & Faceplate, and Level 4 Diagnostics. Demonstrates progressive disclosure navigation (<= 2 clicks to operational context) and upward alarm annunciation rollups.
